saw_lines: Hobbyists compare multicolor upgrades on color change speed and waste, then wait for proof before they reserve anything.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a buyer decides if the swap is worth it.
Your site lists 600 Members, yet 0 of 5 ads carry that proof. Put 600 Members in the first line of every creative and open two ads with a customer quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site lists 600 Members in Discord, yet 0 of 5 ads carry that number, so buyers see no community behind it. Put 600 Members in the first line of every creative and open two ads with a customer quote.
Your site offers 36% off the Quadro reservation, yet only 1 of 5 ads mention it, so most viewers get no reason to act. Put 36% off in the first line of three new ads and on every creative.
Your offer appears after 97% of the copy on a median ad of 108 words, so many viewers stop before reaching it. Move the offer into the first two lines of every ad and cut the body to product facts.
All 5 of your ads use claim words such as clinically, cure and guaranteed results, and that wording limits reach. Say what customers noticed instead, and put that line in the opening of every ad.

ads_1: Test 36% off and 600 members as opening lines against the 1-second color hook
